gen-dafont-bloody-gf-anek-odia: Commanding from the first letter, Bloody swings its lowercase in big round bowls. Shrink the heading and that swagger thins out, while Anek Odia, clean and contemporary, keeps its rounds unsealed like an unlatched hook.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-anek-tamil: Anek Tamil, modern and contemporary, has big round lowercase bowls and half-unwrapped c and s shapes. Anek Tamil then sits under Bloody's commanding display lettering, which shares those round bowls.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-anek-telugu: Huge round lowercase bowls give Bloody its commanding, bloody bite. Anek Telugu, clean and approachable, runs its reading rhythm on wide bowls and rounds left unsealed like an unlatched hook.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-arimo: Big round bowls in the lowercase give Bloody its commanding, bloody attitude, loud enough to carry a whole heading. Arimo steps back, with spacious gaps in its rounded glyphs.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-armata: Commanding bowls, big and round, make Bloody a heading font that dominates at a glance. But Armata does the quieter work, with spacious gaps between characters and lowercase bodies filling most of the letter height.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-atkinson-hyperlegib: Bloody hits hard, with commanding lettering and rounded lowercase bowls. Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono does the opposite job, spacing its letters far apart and letting open counters breathe into the white space.
Generous round bowls in its lowercase make Bloody feel commanding on sight. Atkinson Hyperlegible Next holds the best card on the table: lowercase eyes as big as washers on a line.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-biryani: Round, oversized lowercase bowls give Bloody a commanding, bloody voice, loud enough to lead any page it opens. Biryani can take a size up, since its small counters never clog.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-blinker: Oversized round bowls give Bloody a commanding, bloody swagger. Blinker takes over below with lines that hold their thickness, open apertures that read easily, and lowercase filling most of the height.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Carrois Gothic SC keeps every curve clearly open and makes capital height nearly match lowercase height. Carrois Gothic SC sits beneath Bloody's commanding round-bowled display lettering, contemporary and approachable where the heading is loud.
